# IMAG Teaching Materials {.unnumbered}

This book accompanies the **Cesim Invest** simulation (IMAG). You run Asterion Capital, an
asset manager with up to four funds, one per client type, invested in 180 assets across five
currencies. Each round you read the economic outlook, decide the allocation of every fund in
three layers (strategic, tactical, asset level), set fees, and read the results.

This version documents **the game flow and how to play it well**: what each page of the game
asks for, in what order to decide, how to get the numbers with the allocation app that comes with
the course, and how to read what comes back. One chapter per step. The theory behind each step
(client analysis, capital-market assumptions, mean-variance and Black-Litterman optimization,
performance attribution) is referenced where it is used and will be added in a later edition.

**How to read it.** Chapter 1 shows the whole round on one page. Chapters 2 to 9 follow the
order in which you decide. Appendix A is the reference for the allocation app; appendix B
collects proposed changes to the app and the game.

**The examples.** Every worked example in this book uses two invented clients, the Hartley
family (home market Britain) and the Keller trust (home market the euro area). They are not
clients of the game. The game's own clients have their own rules, their own risk aversion and
their own limits; reading those out of the client cards is your task, and this book shows the
method, not the answers.

::: {.callout-note title="State of the game"}
The client descriptions, the limit sheets and the strategic benchmarks described here are the
October 2026 design. Until Cesim has loaded them into the simulation, the texts and limits you
see on the Clients page may still be the earlier ones. The method does not change.
:::
